title: Ket Maliss
caption: Ket Maliss (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Unless Emperor Palpatine on table, Black Sun agents are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, may ▲ Beedo, Dannik Jerriko, Greedo, Hem Dazon, or Reegesk. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a docking bay. {alter}
lore: Assassins are highly valued by Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters. Ket Maliss, Prince Xizor’s “shadow killer,” has unknown but undoubtedly lethal business in Mos Eisley.
